expected_findings.description: uncopied_rows_predicate compiles the approved deletion predicate against posthog.flag_evaluations and uses it to queue flag rows that have no events copy for deletion. It refuses only predicates that events reads from a property-group map. Events also reads materialized `$` properties from `mat_` columns, which turn an empty string and the string "null" into NULL, while flag_evaluations reads raw JSON. With `$browser` materialized, `properties.$browser = ''` excludes a `{"$browser": ""}` row on events and matches it on flag_evaluations, so the deferred path queues a row the approved predicate excludes; `IS NULL` misses rows the other way. The PR description and the coverage doc record this gap as accepted. The fix refuses predicates whose events compile reads a materialized column, or compiles the flag read with the same normalization. Found by an outside reviewer who ran both compiles on an empty-string row and saw the row queued.
